title: NAM — Numbers as Machines
description: Trilogy III · the executable substrate. A generator-based numerics library where every number is a forkable, deterministic nano-VM emitting an infinite digit stream: a two-tier ABI, signed-digit arithmetic, base-as-codec, p-adics as periodic automata, BBP skip-ahead, and an interval-honest account of equality.
subtitle: Trilogy III · the executable substrate
pitch: A generator-based numerics library where every number is a forkable, deterministic nano-VM emitting an infinite digit stream. RCC's cost classes resurface here as generator state-dimension tiers, with a two-tier ABI, base-as-codec, BBP-as-resonance, and an honest interval account of equality. Where RCC measures and PI_RCC engineers, NAM builds the machine that runs them all.
